observations: Device comes online (DeviceManager callback fires) but active enable of distributed communication does not execute
Logs show device online event is received but does not reach the enable flow
No explicit error message about enable failure; the enable task is simply never created or queued
expected_behavior: After a device comes online, the AccessManager::OnDeviceOnline callback triggers DistributedHardwareManagerFactory::SendOnLineEvent, which creates an OnLineTask that eventually creates EnableTask(s) for each discovered DH capability, completing the online-to-enable chain.
actual_behavior: The device online event is received by AccessManager::OnDeviceOnline but the enable flow is not reached. The callback chain from device-online to enable-task is broken at some intermediate guard or state check.
trigger_sequence: 1. Device A and Device B are connected; Device B goes offline
2. DistributedHardwareManagerFactory::SendOffLineEvent sets flagUnInit_=true when no real-time online devices remain (dh_context.cpp:244-247)
3. Device B comes back online; AccessManager::OnDeviceOnline fires
5. SendOnLineEvent checks flagUnInit_.load() at line 185 — if still true, returns ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_INIT_FAILED
6. Alternatively, if isInit_ is false, Init() is called inline; if Init fails, SendOnLineEvent returns early
7. If neither guard blocks, the IsDeviceOnline duplicate check at line 190 may swallow the event if the previous offline did not fully clean up DHContext online device records
candidate_invariants: flagUnInit_ must be false when a device online event is being processed
DHContext online device set must not contain a device that was previously offline and cleaned up
isInit_ must be true or Init() must succeed before SendOnLineEvent proceeds to create OnLineTask
CapabilityInfo/MetaInfo must be available in DB after SyncDeviceInfo for CreateEnableTask to find capabilities
Component source/sink must be loaded (compSource_/compSink_ non-empty) for Enable to proceed
search_anchors: isInit_ check and Init() call in SendOnLineEvent (line 200)
assumptions: The DeviceManager callback (OnDeviceOnline) fires correctly and reliably
The AccessManager Init and RegisterDevStateCallback succeed at SA startup
The KVDB and softbus dependencies are available when DoBusinessInit runs
The symptom is a reconnection scenario where a device went offline and comes back online
stop_conditions: Root cause identified with code-level evidence
All plausible guard conditions along the chain checked
At least one confirmed or probable finding established
inferred_fields: severity_assessment: critical — device online does not trigger enable, breaking core distributed communication
reproducibility: Likely reproducible in device reconnection scenarios where offline/online events race with UnInit
